days.summary: On the night/morning of 5-6 October 2026, Russian strikes on Kyiv damaged a bridge roadway in Desnianskyi district, set vehicles on fire in a residential courtyard in Pecherskyi district, and caused a minor roof fire at an educational institution in Obolonskyi district.

On 8 October 2026, Russian drone strikes hit Kyiv's Solomianskyi, Shevchenkivskyi, and Holosiivskyi districts, with a direct hit and fire at a four-storey commercial building causing deaths and injuries, and debris falling in open areas including near parked vehicles that caught fire.

On the night/day of 11 October 2026, drone debris fell in two separate districts of Kyiv, damaging a car in Darnytskyi district and landing in a green zone near an apartment building in Holosiivskyi district.

On 14 October 2026, a Russian ballistic missile struck a 9-storey residential building in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district, while separately an electric car exploded in Pecherskyi district, injuring its driver.

On the night of 16 October 2026, Russian strikes caused fires at a non-residential building and a private house in Shevchenkivskyi district and at a non-residential (outbuilding) structure in Solomianskyi district.

On the night of 19 October 2026, Russian strikes on Kyiv damaged a medical diagnostic center, the Chernihivska metro station and surrounding area, the Shalet ice arena, a Datagroup data center, the Cosmo Multimall shopping centre, and the Book Chamber of Ukraine.

On the night of 25 October 2026, drone debris and strikes caused fires and debris falls in open areas of Kyiv's Dniprovskyi and Desnianskyi districts, with no casualties or infrastructure damage reported.

On the night/day of 30 October 2026, Russian strikes on Kyiv caused fires and damage in Darnytskyi, Dniprovskyi, Shevchenkivskyi and other districts, including a fatality, a damaged museum, a damaged apartment building, and a power outage affecting several districts after a hit on energy infrastructure.

On the night of October 31, 2026, drone and debris strikes caused fires and damage at three separate sites in Kyiv's Obolonskyi, Desnianskyi, and Darnytskyi districts, with one woman reported injured.
On the night and day of 2 November 2026, two separate fires broke out in Podilskyi district (a residential building and a car) and drone debris caused a fire in an open area in Darnytskyi district.
On the night of 2026-11-03/04, falling debris was reported in open ground near a private house in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district, with no injuries or further damage specified.
On the night/morning of 5 November 2026, debris from a downed target fell in an open area in Kyiv's Pecherskyi district; no other impacts were reported.
On the night of 2026-11-08, several missiles struck the Pivnichnyi (Northern) Bridge in Kyiv, damaging the road surface, trolleybus contact line, and a power line.
On the night of November 10, 2026, a Russian attack damaged a private house in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.
